White Zip Shirt & Plaid Mini

Source: 25004.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy light blonde
hair wears a white crinkle-texture cropped zip shirt with
a pointed collar and heart-shaped zipper pulls, a small
logo patch, and a black choker with a heart charm. A
gray plaid mini skirt sits under a studded black belt. Her
expression is calm. A casting board of photos behind
her and a softbox at her side. Palette of white, gray,
and black. Playful and preppy, in the style of a
behind-the-scenes Y2K lookbook.
Playful, preppy, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The heart zipper pulls and studded belt are the playful
accents.
- Keep the casting board for an editorial
behind-the-scenes feel.
